svg.title: Preparing one fluorophore reference spectrum from image regions
svg.desc: Schematic numerical example with six acquired bands. Selected stained and matched unstained control regions supply intensity-corrected mean spectra m and u. Separate image background regions supply b_stain and b_control, here 0.2 and 0.1 in every band. Subtraction gives z equal to 2, 4, 7, 9, 4, 3 and the control profile a equal to 1, 2, 3, 2, 1, 1.5. Reviewed dark bands 1, 2 and 6, shaded in both plots, determine alpha equal to 2. Subtraction of alpha times a in all six bands gives the fluorophore profile 0, 0, 1, 5, 2, 0. Three included ROI profiles, each normalized to unit L2 norm, receive equal weights. Their mean is L1-normalized to one stored fluorophore column of reference S. Other component columns are muted and are not derived here. Image marks and all spectra are constructed examples, not measured results.
svg.text: Sample regions and subtract each image's background
